activeNote: Archived tasks 60-87 are treated as completed runtime foundations. This batch focuses on the missing Rust execution spine, runtime bridge, tool pipeline, memory and knowledge integration, reliability, and security before Sub-Agent expansion.

implementationNotes.foundationComplete: Story 43.1-49.4 in task-archived-1.json are reusable foundations and must not be rebuilt in this batch.
implementationNotes.integration: This batch is about connecting existing frontend runtime models to a real backend execution layer.
implementationNotes.backendRequired: Anything involving real execution, persistence, streaming, tools, permissions, knowledge retrieval, audit, or recovery must land in src-tauri/src/agent and Tauri commands.
implementationNotes.deferred: Business pilots, skill ecosystem work, and advanced multi-agent behavior stay out of the critical path until the main Agent loop is stable.

tasks.title: Rust agent core and orchestrator
tasks.description: Create src-tauri/src/agent and land the real backend orchestrator, provider trait, runtime session service, and Tauri command entry points.

existingCode.note: Frontend runtime shells exist, but src-tauri/src/agent does not exist yet.

steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent and module exports
Define AgentOrchestrator, provider trait, and runtime session service
Register agent commands in lib.rs invoke_handler
Define request and response contracts for frontend runtime integration
Ensure the main execution loop is interruptible, traceable, and persistable

tasks.title: Runtime event streaming bridge
tasks.description: Upgrade the frontend event model into a real frontend-backend runtime event bridge for progress, tool, error, and completion events.

existingCode.note: Current event emission is local to the frontend and not driven by real backend execution.

steps: Define runtime event protocol and event type mapping
Implement backend to frontend event bridge
Connect StreamingHostContext to the real event source
Handle ordering, reconnect, replay, and interruption consistency
Verify chat and debug panels consume real runtime events

tasks.title: Real tool execution pipeline
tasks.description: Connect the existing tool models to a real backend execution pipeline, including core tool registration, permission checks, confirmation flow, and result normalization.

existingCode.note: registerCoreTools is still a placeholder and there is no backend ToolExecutionPipeline.

steps: Implement backend ToolExecutionPipeline
Bind tool descriptors to real executors
Register core tools and remove placeholder behavior
Integrate permission checks, sensitive action detection, and confirmation flow
Normalize tool results and errors into one runtime contract

tasks.title: Chat host integration and E2E baseline
tasks.description: Remove the simulated chat response path and connect the chat panel, staged review, and writeback flow to the real runtime, then add the minimum end-to-end harness.

existingCode.note: AgentChatPanel still falls back to simulateResponse today.

steps: Remove the default simulateResponse path
Connect MessageInput, MessageList, and StagedReviewPanel to the real runtime
Close the loop from user input to tool call to staged writeback to apply
Add a mock provider and a minimum tool set for runtime tests
Add end-to-end coverage for the main Agent loop

tasks.title: Prompt builder and provider request path
tasks.description: Create the real prompt assembly and provider request path for the common Agent runtime.

existingCode.note: There is no Agent-specific provider layer yet.

steps: Define provider traits and request-response contracts
Implement PromptBuilder with system prompt, runtime context, and tool visibility
Support provider selection, timeout, retry, and error mapping
Connect PromptBuilder to AgentOrchestrator
Persist model outputs through the runtime pipeline

tasks.title: Context compression and session summary persistence
tasks.description: Turn the existing summary and compression model into real backend persistence and runtime token budget control.

existingCode.note: The summary model exists, but it is not yet part of real backend runtime behavior.

steps: Create summary refresh triggers and persistence structures
Generate reusable session summaries and key facts from real history
Implement token budget and compression policy
Feed compressed context back into PromptBuilder
Add restore, refresh, and expiry behavior

tasks.title: Knowledge retrieval integration
tasks.description: Replace the mock retrieval path with real backend retrieval over storage, vector, and scoped knowledge sources.
steps: Create backend retrieval service
Replace mockRetrieve with real async retrieval
Enforce scope filters for tenant, department, and session
Inject retrieval results into planner, runtime, and tool context
Add caching, timeout, and degradation behavior

tasks.title: Retry, replan, and checkpoint recovery
tasks.description: Connect replan strategy, checkpoint management, and failure recovery to real backend execution records and restore flows.

existingCode.note: Recovery models exist, but there is no actual backend recovery loop yet.

steps: Connect retry and replan decisions to real execution outcomes
Implement checkpoint save, activate, rollback, and restore
Trigger recovery from tool failure, timeout, and interruption
Feed recovery state back to chat and debug views
Verify interruption, retry, rollback, and restore end to end

tasks.title: Trace, audit, and failure persistence
tasks.description: Turn trace, tool audit, and failure recording into real backend persistence and query capabilities.

existingCode.note: The models exist, but there are no backend trace or audit records yet.

steps: Design trace, tool audit, and execution record storage
Write trace and audit events from orchestrator and tool pipeline
Expose query commands by session, trace, tool, and task
Connect debug panels to real data sources
Ensure audit coverage for tool calls, confirmations, failures, and results

tasks.title: Runtime metrics and debug telemetry
tasks.description: Replace mock observability with real runtime metrics, logs, and diagnostic telemetry.

existingCode.note: Current observability panels still contain mock data.

steps: Define runtime metric collection points
Persist telemetry and expose aggregate queries
Connect metrics panels to real data
Support session and tenant level statistics
Emit structured diagnostics for troubleshooting

tasks.title: Backend-enforced security and confirmation
tasks.description: Move sensitive action detection, input validation, field permissions, and confirmation flow into backend-enforced runtime guards.

existingCode.note: Security and confirmation are still largely frontend-side decisions today.

steps: Move sensitive input and dangerous action checks into backend guards
Implement backend confirmation, rejection, and permission-denied flows
Add allow and block policy for system, path, and network tools
Add second-pass validation for risky writeback and outbound requests
Write security events into audit records

tasks.title: Controlled correction-rule baseline
tasks.description: Add correction-rule read, match, and suggestion output after the main Agent loop is stable, without allowing automatic config mutation.

existingCode.note: Correction support exists mostly as UI and model scaffolding.

steps: Add correction rule read and match capability
Inject rule suggestions into planner and runtime without auto-mutation
Link rule hits to failure and audit records
Output reviewable improvement suggestions

tasks.title: Sub-Agent routing baseline
tasks.description: Only after the main Agent loop is stable, add routing for delegated Sub-Agent calls based on keywords, intent, and scenario matching.

existingCode.note: The UI exists before the runtime capability and must remain a deferred path.

steps: Create routing service for keyword, intent, and scenario matching
Base delegation decisions on real runtime context
Write routing outcomes into the main trace

tasks.title: Sub-Agent execution context and isolation
tasks.description: Create isolated execution context, memory scope, tool filtering, and permission inheritance or shrinkage for Sub-Agent calls.

existingCode.note: There is no real backend implementation for Sub-Agent execution context yet.

steps: Create SubAgentExecutionContext and tool filtering
Project main Agent context into isolated Sub-Agent context
Ensure permissions can only inherit or shrink
Link Sub-Agent calls back to the main trace
Provide the shared context model needed by later Sub-Agent tasks

tasks.title: Sub-Agent nested call control
tasks.description: Add nested call depth limits, loop detection, budgets, and timeout control to prevent recursive multi-agent failure modes.

existingCode.note: This is an advanced capability and must follow a verified single-layer Sub-Agent path.

steps: Track nested depth and enforce limits
Add loop detection and call budgets
Propagate timeout and failure correctly
Link nested calls to trace, audit, and failure records
Verify no unbounded recursion or privilege escalation

tasks.title: Sub-Agent result return and merge
tasks.description: Return Sub-Agent summaries, failures, and outputs back into the main Agent session in a reviewable and traceable form.

existingCode.note: Result return belongs after isolation and nested-call control.

steps: Normalize Sub-Agent result and summary payloads
Merge results and failures back into the main Agent context
Allow main Agent replanning or review handoff based on returned results
Preserve context boundaries during result merge
Add visible debug and review data for parent-child Agent interaction

tasks.title: Sub-Agent monitoring and diagnostics
tasks.description: After real Sub-Agent execution exists, add monitoring, linked traces, metrics, and diagnostics for multi-agent execution.

existingCode.note: Monitoring depends on real Sub-Agent execution and trace links.

steps: Add metrics for Sub-Agent latency, failure rate, and token usage
Connect Sub-Agent monitoring to the shared telemetry and trace stack
